summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Opus Small Cap Value ETF (OSCV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund is an actively managed fund that selects US small-cap companies and REITs based on valuation plus quality and growth metrics. The fund seeks capital appreciation. OSCV was launched on Jul 18, 2018 and is issued by Opus Capital Management.

holdings.infoBox: OSCV is an equity ETF with a total of 69 individual holdings. The top holdings are First American Treasury Obligs X stock at 4.58%, The Hanover Insurance Group at 3.13%, The Ensign Group at 2.63%, Encompass Health at 2.55%, and Viper Energy at 2.54%.
